items.title: Visual agent workflows with durable local jobs
items.goal: Submit bounded work from Langflow and follow saved-agent sessions and evidence without duplicate starts.
acceptance: An agent proposal remains unpublished and reviewable
Idempotency, authorization and interruption checks pass

items.title: Inspect and edit a feature plan before implementation
items.goal: As project owner I can inspect scope, ownership and acceptance evidence before agents implement a feature.
acceptance: Product, technical and QA handovers are visible
A plan cannot certify a game feature as complete

items.title: Review an agent change without silently activating it
items.goal: As project owner I can see the exact candidate diff, reviews and outstanding evaluation before deciding its direction.
acceptance: Decision is bound to the candidate result hash
No publication or self-approval endpoint exists

items.title: R0-001: one tree family and one scan conversion
items.goal: Deliver a reusable measured asset recipe and a source/derivative comparison.
acceptance: One oak family relinked and checked in neutral views
One scan derivative compared against source
Godot scene records visual and frame-time evidence

items.title: M0: small playable Swedish forest benchmark
items.goal: Evaluate an editable forest scene and renderer choice on measured target hardware.
acceptance: Reproducible biome seed and painted override
Actual hardware and measurement protocol recorded
